name: TRIOSTEUM PERFOLIATUM
key_symptoms: Loathing of food; nausea on rising, followed by vomiting and cramps. Stools watery, frothy.
Occipital pain, with nausea on rising, followed by vomiting. Influenza, with aching pains all over, and heat in the limbs. Ozæna; frontal pain.
Stiffness of all joints; calves numb; aching in bones. Rheumatic pain in back. Pains in limbs.
